<style>
/* ===== FONTES PROPRIAS ===================================== */
@font-face{font-family:'Recoleta';
  src:url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Recoleta%20Light.woff2') format('woff2'),
      url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Recoleta%20Light.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight:300;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'Recoleta';
  src:url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Recoleta%20Regular.woff2') format('woff2'),
      url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Recoleta%20Regular.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'Recoleta';
  src:url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Recoleta%20SemiBold.woff2') format('woff2'),
      url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Recoleta%20SemiBold.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight:600;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'Recoleta';
  src:url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Recoleta%20Bold.woff2') format('woff2'),
      url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Recoleta%20Bold.ttf') format('truetype');
  font-weight:700;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}
@font-face{font-family:'Pinopolis';
  src:url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Pinopolis.woff2') format('woff2'),
      url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/Pinopolis.woff') format('woff'),
      url('https://cacaucosmo.com.br/wp-content/uploads/fonts/PINOPOLIS.TTF') format('truetype');
  font-weight:400;font-style:normal;font-display:swap}

/* ===== TOKENS ============================================== */
:root{
  --cc-navy:#00062E; --cc-navy-2:#0A1240;
  --cc-pink:#D293A8; --cc-blush:#E9D9D2;
  --cc-cream:#F1E8D0; --cc-paper:#EFE8DC;
  --cc-gold:#C9A84C;  --cc-brown:#4A2C1D;
  --cc-text-light:#F1E8D0; --cc-text-dark:#00062E;

  --font-display:'Recoleta',Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;
  --font-body:'Syne','Helvetica Neue',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;
  --font-mono:'Pinopolis','Iowan Old Style','Palatino Linotype',Georgia,serif;

  --pad:clamp(22px,4.4vw,74px);
  --bar:clamp(76px,7vw,108px);
  --wrap:1240px;
  --ease:cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
}

/* ===== BASE ================================================ */
.cc *,.cc *::before,.cc *::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;font-family:var(--font-mono);background:var(--cc-navy);color:var(--cc-text-light);
  line-height:1.7;overflow-x:hidden;font-size:clamp(14px,1vw,16px)}
.cc h1,.cc h2,.cc h3,.cc h4,.cc p,.cc ul,.cc ol,.cc figure,.cc blockquote{margin:0;padding:0}
.cc img{display:block;max-width:100%;height:auto}
.cc a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.cc button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer;padding:0}
.cc :focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--cc-gold);outline-offset:3px}
.cc [hidden],.drawer [hidden]{display:none!important}
::selection{background:var(--cc-pink);color:var(--cc-navy)}

/* TITULOS Recoleta / CORPO Pinopolis / CABECALHO-RODAPE Syne */
.cc h1,.cc h2,.cc h3,.cc h4,.cc .display,.cc .em{font-family:var(--font-display)!important}
.cc,.cc p,.cc li,.cc .label,.cc .cta,.cc input,.cc textarea,.cc select{font-family:var(--font-mono)}
.topbar,.topbar *,.drawer,.drawer *,.footer,.footer *,.cc .ui,.cc .ui *{font-family:var(--font-body)!important}
.footer .footer__claim,.drawer .nav a,.drawer .drawer__quote p{font-family:var(--font-display)!important}

.cc .label{font-size:clamp(9px,.66vw,11px);letter-spacing:.36em;text-transform:uppercase;
  font-weight:600;color:var(--cc-gold);text-indent:.36em}
.cc .display{font-weight:700;line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.015em}
.cc .em{font-style:italic;color:var(--cc-pink)}
.cc .wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;width:100%}

.rv{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);
  transition:opacity 1s var(--ease),transform 1s var(--ease)}
.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.d1{transition-delay:.08s}.d2{transition-delay:.16s}.d3{transition-delay:.24s}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  .rv{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}}
/* No editor do Elementor tudo aparece sem animacao */
.elementor-editor-active .rv{opacity:1;transform:none}

.stars{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;pointer-events:none}

/* ===== BOTOES / LINKS ====================================== */
.cc .cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;margin-top:clamp(16px,1.9vw,26px);
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.28em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;
  padding-bottom:7px;border-bottom:1px solid currentColor;width:fit-content;
  transition:gap .5s var(--ease)}
.cc .cta:hover{gap:20px}
.cc .btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;
  background:var(--cc-navy);color:var(--cc-cream);font-family:var(--font-body)!important;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;
  padding:17px 30px;border:1px solid var(--cc-navy);transition:background .5s var(--ease),color .5s,border-color .5s}
.cc .btn:hover{background:var(--cc-gold);border-color:var(--cc-gold);color:var(--cc-navy)}
.cc .btn--pink{background:var(--cc-pink);border-color:var(--cc-pink);color:var(--cc-navy)}
.cc .btn--ghost{background:transparent;color:currentColor;border-color:currentColor}

/* ===== TOPO FIXO =========================================== */
.topbar{position:fixed;top:0;left:0;right:0;z-index:9990;height:var(--bar);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 1fr;align-items:center;
  padding:0 var(--pad);transition:background .6s var(--ease);color:var(--cc-cream)}
.admin-bar .topbar{top:32px}
.topbar.solid{background:rgba(0,6,46,.92);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
  border-bottom:1px solid rgba(241,232,208,.1)}
.topbar button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
.topbar a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.burger{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;padding:10px!important;margin-left:-10px;justify-self:start}
.burger span{display:block;width:24px;height:1px;background:var(--cc-cream);
  transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
.burger:hover span:nth-child(1){transform:translateX(4px)}
.burger:hover span:nth-child(3){transform:translateX(-4px)}

.brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:7px;justify-self:center;color:var(--cc-cream)}
.brand img,.brand svg{width:clamp(38px,3vw,48px);height:auto;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.brand b{font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(8px,.62vw,10px);letter-spacing:.38em;
  text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cc-cream);text-indent:.38em;white-space:nowrap}

.util{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(12px,1.6vw,26px);justify-self:end}
.lang{display:flex;gap:10px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em}
.lang button{opacity:.5;transition:opacity .4s;padding:0}
.lang button.on,.lang button:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--cc-gold)}
.cc-cartlink{opacity:.85;transition:opacity .4s;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.14em}
.cc-cartlink:hover{opacity:1}
.cc-cartlink svg{width:17px;height:17px;color:var(--cc-cream)}
.cc-acct{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.85;transition:opacity .4s}
.cc-acct:hover{opacity:1}
.cc-acct svg{width:18px;height:18px;color:var(--cc-cream)}
.cc-sair{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.55;transition:opacity .4s;
  padding-left:clamp(12px,1.6vw,26px);border-left:1px solid rgba(241,232,208,.25)}
.cc-sair:hover{opacity:1}
.cart__n{min-width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--cc-pink);color:var(--cc-navy);
  font-size:9px;font-weight:700;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:0 4px;letter-spacing:0}
.cart__n.on{display:inline-flex}

/* ===== MENU LATERAL ======================================== */
.scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9995;background:rgba(0,6,46,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(3px);
  opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),visibility .7s}
.scrim.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible}

.drawer{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;z-index:9999;height:100dvh;width:32%;min-width:400px;
  background:var(--cc-navy);color:var(--cc-cream);transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .85s var(--ease);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:clamp(26px,2.6vw,40px) clamp(30px,3.4vw,58px);
  border-left:1px solid rgba(241,232,208,.12);overflow:hidden auto;box-sizing:border-box}
.drawer *{box-sizing:border-box}
.drawer a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.drawer button{font:inherit;color:inherit;background:none;border:0;cursor:pointer}
.drawer p{margin:0}
.drawer.open{transform:none}
.drawer .stars{opacity:.55}
.drawer__top{display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;position:relative}
.close{font-size:24px!important;line-height:1;padding:10px!important;margin:-10px;transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
.close:hover{transform:rotate(90deg)}

.nav{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(8px,1vw,14px);
  padding:clamp(30px,5vh,62px) 0 0;position:relative}
.nav a{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(22px,2vw,32px);
  color:var(--cc-cream);letter-spacing:.04em;opacity:0;transform:translateX(18px);
  display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;line-height:1.3;
  transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),transform .7s var(--ease),color .4s}
.drawer.open .nav a{opacity:1;transform:none}
.drawer.open .nav a:nth-child(1){transition-delay:.16s}
.drawer.open .nav a:nth-child(2){transition-delay:.21s}
.drawer.open .nav a:nth-child(3){transition-delay:.26s}
.drawer.open .nav a:nth-child(4){transition-delay:.31s}
.drawer.open .nav a:nth-child(5){transition-delay:.36s}
.drawer.open .nav a:nth-child(6){transition-delay:.41s}
.nav a:hover,.nav a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--cc-pink)}

.drawer__rule{width:64px;height:1px;background:rgba(241,232,208,.3);
  margin:clamp(26px,3vw,40px) 0;position:relative}
.btn-circle{display:block;text-align:center;background:var(--cc-pink);color:var(--cc-navy)!important;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;
  padding:16px 20px;position:relative;transition:background .5s var(--ease)}
.btn-circle:hover{background:var(--cc-gold)}
.btn-acct{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px}
.btn-acct svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.drawer__sair{display:block;text-align:center;margin-top:14px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.62;transition:opacity .4s;position:relative}
.drawer__sair:hover{opacity:1}
.js-sair[hidden]{display:none!important}
.drawer__links{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:clamp(24px,2.6vw,34px);position:relative}
.drawer__links a{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.26em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.62;transition:opacity .4s}
.drawer__links a:hover{opacity:1}
.drawer__quote{margin-top:auto;padding-top:40px;position:relative}
.drawer__quote p{font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(15px,1.3vw,19px);line-height:1.6;color:var(--cc-cream);opacity:.9}
.drawer__lang{display:flex;gap:14px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.22em;
  margin-top:clamp(22px,2.4vw,32px);position:relative}
.drawer__lang button{opacity:.5;transition:opacity .4s}
.drawer__lang button.on{opacity:1;border-bottom:1px solid var(--cc-gold);padding-bottom:3px}

/* ===== HERO DE PAGINA INTERNA ============================== */
.cc .phero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--cc-navy);color:var(--cc-cream);
  min-height:clamp(380px,58svh,640px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:calc(var(--bar) + 6vh) var(--pad) 9vh}
.cc .phero .orb{position:absolute;right:-14%;top:4%;width:min(54vw,700px);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(38% 38% at 34% 30%,rgba(210,147,168,.22) 0%,rgba(74,44,29,.20) 45%,rgba(0,6,46,0) 72%);
  pointer-events:none}
.cc .phero .orb::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(210,147,168,.13)}
.cc .phero>*:not(.stars):not(.orb){position:relative}
.cc .phero h1{font-size:clamp(36px,5.8vw,92px);max-width:16ch;margin-top:clamp(14px,1.7vw,22px)}
.cc .phero__sub{margin-top:clamp(16px,1.8vw,24px);font-size:clamp(13px,1.1vw,17px);opacity:.82;max-width:44ch}
.cc .crumbs{position:absolute!important;bottom:clamp(20px,3.4vh,38px);left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  font-family:var(--font-body)!important;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.55;white-space:nowrap}
.cc .crumbs a:hover{color:var(--cc-gold)}

/* ===== FOOTER ============================================== */
.footer{background:var(--cc-paper);color:var(--cc-text-dark);
  padding:clamp(20px,2.2vw,34px) var(--pad);
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto auto;align-items:center;
  gap:clamp(18px,3vw,50px);border-top:1px solid rgba(0,6,46,.1);box-sizing:border-box}
.footer *{box-sizing:border-box}
.footer a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.footer p{margin:0}
.footer__brand{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;color:var(--cc-navy)}
.footer__brand img,.footer__brand svg{width:96px;height:auto;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.footer__nav{display:flex;gap:clamp(14px,1.8vw,28px);flex-wrap:wrap;justify-self:center}
.footer__nav a{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:600;opacity:.72;transition:opacity .4s,color .4s}
.footer__nav a:hover{opacity:1;color:var(--cc-brown)}
.footer__place{font-size:12px;opacity:.7}
.footer__claim{font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(10px,.9vw,13px);
  letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cc-brown)}
.footer__right{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-end;gap:6px}
.footer__social{display:flex;gap:14px}
.footer__social a{opacity:.7;transition:opacity .4s}
.footer__social a:hover{opacity:1}
.footer__social svg{width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--cc-navy);display:block}
.footer__legal{grid-column:1/-1;display:flex;gap:22px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding-top:16px;margin-top:6px;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,6,46,.1)}
.footer__legal a,.footer__legal small{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.5}
.footer__legal a:hover{opacity:.9}

/* ===== RESPONSIVO (comum) ================================== */
@media (max-width:900px){
  .drawer{width:46%;min-width:330px}
  .footer{grid-template-columns:1fr;justify-items:center;text-align:center;gap:20px}
  .footer__right{align-items:center}
  .footer__nav{justify-content:center}
}
@media (max-width:782px){.admin-bar .topbar{top:46px}}
@media (max-width:620px){
  .drawer{width:100%;min-width:0;border-left:0}
  .util .lang{display:none}
  .cc-acct span,.util .cc-sair{display:none}
  .cc .crumbs{white-space:normal;width:90%;text-align:center}
}
</style>

<script>
/* ===== FALLBACK DO LOGO ==================================== */
function ccFallback(img){
  var w = img.getBoundingClientRect().width || 40;
  var s = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','svg');
  s.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 120 74');
  s.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
  s.style.width = w + 'px'; s.style.height = 'auto'; s.style.display = 'block';
  s.style.color = 'currentColor';
  var u = document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/2000/svg','use');
  u.setAttribute('href','#cc-mark'); s.appendChild(u);
  img.replaceWith(s);
}

</script>

<style>
/* ===== QUEM SOMOS ========================================== */

/* 2 - Historia (split) */
.cc .story{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;background:var(--cc-cream);color:var(--cc-text-dark)}
.cc .story__media{position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:clamp(380px,62vh,720px);background:var(--cc-brown)}
.cc .story__media img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.cc .artframe{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center}
.cc .artframe svg{width:min(46%,280px);height:auto}
.cc .story__body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(36px,5vw,96px)}
.cc .story__body h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,54px);margin:14px 0 22px;max-width:14ch}
.cc .story__body p{max-width:46ch;opacity:.84;margin-bottom:14px}
.cc .story__body p.lead{font-family:var(--font-display)!important;font-style:italic;font-size:clamp(17px,1.5vw,23px);
  line-height:1.5;opacity:1;color:var(--cc-brown)}
.cc .sig{margin-top:22px;line-height:1.55}
.cc .sig b{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(15px,1.25vw,19px)}
.cc .sig i{font-style:normal;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.6}

/* 3 - Manifesto */
.cc .manifesto{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--cc-navy);color:var(--cc-cream);
  padding:clamp(70px,9vw,150px) var(--pad);text-align:center}
.cc .manifesto>*:not(.stars){position:relative}
.cc .manifesto h2{font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,64px);margin:14px 0 clamp(26px,3vw,44px)}
.cc .manifesto__lines{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:clamp(18px,2vw,28px);max-width:40ch;margin:0 auto}
.cc .manifesto__lines p{font-size:clamp(15px,1.3vw,20px);opacity:.88;line-height:1.75}
.cc .pillar{margin:clamp(30px,3.4vw,52px) auto;padding:clamp(14px,1.5vw,20px) 0;max-width:34ch;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.4);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(201,168,76,.4)}
.cc .pillar span{font-family:var(--font-display)!important;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(16px,1.6vw,24px);
  color:var(--cc-gold);letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;display:block}

/* 4 - Principios */
.cc .values{background:var(--cc-paper);color:var(--cc-text-dark);padding:clamp(70px,8vw,130px) var(--pad)}
.cc .values__head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:30px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  margin-bottom:clamp(36px,4vw,64px)}
.cc .values__head h2{font-size:clamp(28px,3.4vw,54px);max-width:16ch;margin-top:12px}
.cc .values__head p{max-width:38ch;opacity:.76}
.cc .values__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);border-top:1px solid rgba(0,6,46,.16)}
.cc .value{padding:clamp(26px,2.6vw,40px) clamp(18px,1.8vw,30px) 10px 0;border-right:1px solid rgba(0,6,46,.1)}

<script>
(function(){
  /* ===== MENU LATERAL ====================================== */
  var drawer=document.getElementById('drawer'), scrim=document.getElementById('scrim'),
      burger=document.getElementById('burger'), closeBtn=document.getElementById('close');
  if(drawer&&burger){
    var open=function(){
      scrim.hidden=false;
      requestAnimationFrame(function(){drawer.classList.add('open');scrim.classList.add('open')});
      drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
      burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','true');
      document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
      drawer.querySelector('.nav a').focus({preventScroll:true});
    };
    var close=function(){
      drawer.classList.remove('open'); scrim.classList.remove('open');
      drawer.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');
      document.body.style.overflow='';
      setTimeout(function(){scrim.hidden=true},700);
      burger.focus({preventScroll:true});
    };
    burger.addEventListener('click',open);
    closeBtn.addEventListener('click',close);
    scrim.addEventListener('click',close);
    document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
      if(e.key==='Escape'&&drawer.classList.contains('open'))close();
    });
    drawer.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(function(a){a.addEventListener('click',close)});
  }

  /* ===== LINK DA PAGINA ATUAL ============================== */
  var here=location.pathname.replace(/\/+$/,'')||'/';
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav a, .footer__nav a').forEach(function(a){
    var p=(a.getAttribute('href')||'').replace(/\/+$/,'')||'/';
    if(p===here||(p!=='/'&&here.indexOf(p+'/')===0)) a.setAttribute('aria-current','page');
  });

  /* ===== TOPO GANHA FUNDO ================================== */
  var bar=document.getElementById('topbar');
  if(bar){
    var f=function(){bar.classList.toggle('solid',window.scrollY>60)};
    window.addEventListener('scroll',f,{passive:true}); f();
  }

  /* ===== REVEAL ============================================ */
  var els=document.querySelectorAll('.rv');
  if(!('IntersectionObserver' in window)){els.forEach(function(e){e.classList.add('in')})}
  else{
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(en){
      en.forEach(function(e){if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('in');io.unobserve(e.target)}});
    },{threshold:.14,rootMargin:'0px 0px -6% 0px'});
    els.forEach(function(e){io.observe(e)});
  }

  /* ===== CAMPO ESTELAR ===================================== */
  function paint(c){
    var ctx=c.getContext('2d'), dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2),
        r=c.getBoundingClientRect(), density=+c.getAttribute('data-density')||6000;
    if(!r.width||!r.height)return;
    c.width=r.width*dpr; c.height=r.height*dpr; ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);
    ctx.clearRect(0,0,r.width,r.height);
    var n=Math.round(r.width*r.height/density);
    for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
      var x=Math.random()*r.width, y=Math.random()*r.height, m=Math.random(),
          rad=.3+Math.pow(m,3)*1.6;
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.fillStyle = m>.95 ? 'rgba(201,168,76,.9)' : 'rgba(241,232,208,'+(.16+m*.42)+')';
      ctx.arc(x,y,rad,0,Math.PI*2); ctx.fill();
    }
  }
  function all(){document.querySelectorAll('canvas.stars').forEach(paint)}
  if(document.readyState==='complete')all(); else window.addEventListener('load',all);
  var t; window.addEventListener('resize',function(){clearTimeout(t);t=setTimeout(all,220)});
  if(burger)burger.addEventListener('click',function(){setTimeout(all,140)});

  /* ===== CONTADOR DO CARRINHO (WooCommerce Store API) ====== */
  var cartN=document.getElementById('cartN');
  function cart(){
    if(!cartN||!window.fetch)return;
    fetch('/wp-json/wc/store/v1/cart',{credentials:'same-origin'})
      .then(function(r){return r.ok?r.json():null})
      .then(function(d){
        if(!d)return;
        var n=d.items_count||0;
        cartN.textContent=n; cartN.classList.toggle('on',n>0);
      }).catch(function(){});
  }
  cart();
  if(window.jQuery){jQuery(document.body).on('added_to_cart removed_from_cart updated_cart_totals',cart)}

  /* ===== MINHA CONTA / SAIR ================================ */
  var U=window.CC_USER||{logado:document.body.classList.contains('logged-in')};
  document.querySelectorAll('.js-sair').forEach(function(a){
    if(!U.logado){a.hidden=true;return}
    if(U.sair)a.href=U.sair;
  });
  if(!U.logado)document.querySelectorAll('.js-acct-txt').forEach(function(e){
    e.setAttribute('data-i18n','t-login'); e.textContent='Entrar';
  });

  document.querySelectorAll('.js-ano').forEach(function(e){e.textContent=new Date().getFullYear()});
})();

  };
  var extra = window.CC_DICT || {};
  for (var k in extra) dict[k] = extra[k];

  var innerEls = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n]'));
  var phEls = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('[data-i18n-placeholder]'));
  innerEls.forEach(function(el){ el.dataset.pt = el.innerHTML; });
  phEls.forEach(function(el){ el.dataset.ptPlaceholder = el.placeholder; });

  function apply(lang){
    var isEN = lang === 'en';
    innerEls.forEach(function(el){
      var key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n');
      el.innerHTML = isEN ? (dict[key] || el.dataset.pt) : el.dataset.pt;
    });
    phEls.forEach(function(el){
      var key = el.getAttribute('data-i18n-placeholder');
      el.placeholder = isEN ? (dict[key] || el.dataset.ptPlaceholder) : el.dataset.ptPlaceholder;
    });
    document.documentElement.lang = isEN ? 'en' : 'pt-BR';
    document.querySelectorAll('.lang button, .drawer__lang button').forEach(function(b){
      var on = b.getAttribute('data-lang') === lang;
      b.classList.toggle('on', on);
      b.setAttribute('aria-pressed', String(on));
    });
    try{ localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, lang); }catch(e){}
  }
  document.querySelectorAll('.lang button, .drawer__lang button').forEach(function(b){
    b.addEventListener('click', function(){ apply(b.getAttribute('data-lang')); });
  });
  var saved = null;
  try{ saved = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY); }catch(e){}
  if(saved === 'en') apply('en');
})();
